https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
OVN, the Open Virtual Network, is a system to support virtual network abstraction.  OVN complements the existing capabilities of OVS to add native support for virtual network abstractions, such as virtual L2 and L3 overlays and security groups.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Packet Loss Between VMs on DPDK Compute Nodes  - Issue Persists Despite All Recommendations of KCS(7076184) Applied (JIRA:FDP-1341)

* BW limit not applied to VM with VLAN port whose compute's NIC has type=system (JIRA:FDP-1472)

* OVN routers cause exact match on IPv6 external addresses in OVS datapath (JIRA:FDP-1557)

* Static MAC binding "referential integrity violation" (JIRA:FDP-1623)

* OVN 24.03 FDP-ovn-25.8 RHEL 9 Release (JIRA:FDP-1668)

* CLONE - Auto last hop behavior not working with ipv6 (ecmp-symmetric-reply) (JIRA:FDP-374)

* CLONE - OVN DNS responder broken with EDNS/AR (additional records) (JIRA:FDP-392)
